name: tt_op_smd

name: tt_op_scvtci

name: tt_op_sswci

name: tt_op_ssw

name: tt_op_szp

name: tt_op_push_advance_width

name: tt_op_dup

name: tt_op_clear
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), returns void, ret 0

name: tt_op_swap
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), returns void, ret 0

name: tt_op_depth
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), returns void, ret 0

name: tt_op_cindex
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), returns void, ret 0

name: tt_op_mindex

name: tt_op_roll

name: tt_op_mdap

name: tt_op_miap

name: tt_op_iup

name: tt_op_shp

name: tt_op_shz
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: SHZ[a]: pops a zone and shifts all points of that zone by the reference point displacement.

name: tt_op_shpix
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0

name: tt_op_ip
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0

name: tt_op_msirp
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: MSIRP[a]: pops a distance and a point, moves the point to the stated distance from rp0, and updates rp1, rp2 and optionally rp0.

name: tt_op_alignrp
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: ALIGNRP: moves each loop-count point onto rp0 by removing its projected distance to rp0.

name: tt_op_alignpts
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: ALIGNPTS: pops two points and moves both by half of their projected distance so they line up.

name: tt_op_sangw
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: SANGW: pops a word and stores it as the angle weight in the graphics state.

name: tt_op_flippt
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: FLIPPT: pops loop-count points and toggles the on-curve bit of each point flag.

name: tt_op_fliprgon
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: FLIPRGON: pops a start and end point and sets the on-curve bit for every point in the range.

name: tt_op_fliprgoff
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: FLIPRGOFF: pops a start and end point and clears the on-curve bit for every point in the range.

name: tt_op_scanctrl
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: SCANCTRL: pops a value and stores it in the low half of the scan control word.

name: tt_op_scantype
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: SCANTYPE: pops a value 0, 1 or 2 and stores it in the high half of the scan control word.

name: tt_op_instctrl
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: INSTCTRL: pops a selector and a value and sets or clears instruction control bit 0 or 1.

name: tt_op_aa
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: AA: pops a point and searches a table of 20 candidate angles for the best vector, then sets the vectors and positions the point.

name: tt_op_pushb
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: PUSHB[n]: pushes the n+1 bytes that follow the opcode onto the interpreter stack as 32-bit values.

name: tt_op_npushb
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: NPUSHB: reads a one-byte count then pushes that many following bytes onto the stack as 32-bit values.

name: tt_op_pushw
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: PUSHW[n]: pushes the n+1 big-endian 16-bit words that follow the opcode, sign-extended, onto the stack.

name: tt_op_npushw
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: NPUSHW: reads a one-byte count then pushes that many big-endian signed words onto the stack.

name: tt_op_ws
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: WS: pops a value and an index and writes the value into the storage area.

name: tt_op_rs
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: RS: pops an index and pushes the storage area value at that index.

name: tt_op_wcvtp
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: WCVTP: pops a value and an index, writes the value to the control value table, and rescales it against the callback result.

name: tt_op_wcvtf
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: WCVTF: pops a value and an index, converts the value through a context method, and writes it to the control value table.

name: tt_op_rcvt
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: RCVT: pops a control value table index and pushes the scaled value that a callback returns for it.

name: tt_op_gc
convention: cdecl, one argument: interpreter context pointer, ret 0
purpose: GC[a]: pops a point and pushes its coordinate measured along the projection vector, original or current by flag.

name: tt_op_scfs

name: tt_op_md
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0

name: tt_op_mppem
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x4B MPPEM. Pushes the pixels per em of the current size, stretched by the x and y ratios for slanted vectors.

name: tt_op_mps
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x4C MPS. Pushes the point size of the current size onto the interpreter stack.

name: tt_op_getinfo
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x88 GETINFO. Pops a selector and pushes an information word that holds the interpreter version and flags set from the size record.

name: tt_op_flipon
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x4D FLIPON. Sets the auto flip flag of the graphics state.

name: tt_op_flipoff
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x4E FLIPOFF. Clears the auto flip flag of the graphics state.

name: tt_op_debug
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x4F DEBUG. Pops one value from the interpreter stack and discards it.

name: tt_op_binary_arith_compare
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Handles the comparison, logic and arithmetic opcodes LT to NEQ, AND, OR, ADD to MUL, MAX and MIN. Pops two values, pushes one.

name: tt_op_unary_math
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcodes ODD, EVEN, NOT, ABS, NEG, FLOOR and CEILING. Replaces the top stack value with the result chosen by the opcode.

name: tt_op_if
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0

name: tt_op_else
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x1B ELSE. Skips the instruction stream to the matching EIF, stepping over push data and nested IF blocks.

name: tt_op_eif
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x59 EIF. Does nothing, because it only marks the end of an IF block.

name: tt_op_jmpr
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x1C JMPR. Pops an offset and moves the instruction pointer by that many bytes.

name: tt_op_jrot
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x78 JROT. Pops a condition and an offset and jumps by the offset when the condition is nonzero.

name: tt_op_jrof
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x79 JROF. Pops a condition and an offset and jumps by the offset when the condition is zero.

name: tt_op_round
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcodes 0x68 to 0x6B ROUND[ab]. Pops a distance and pushes it rounded by the current round function.

name: tt_op_nround
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcodes 0x6C to 0x6F NROUND[ab]. Leaves the top stack value unchanged, because no engine compensation applies.

name: tt_op_mdrp
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcodes 0xC0 to 0xDF MDRP. Pops a point and moves it from reference point 0 by the original distance, with optional rounding.

name: tt_op_mirp
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcodes 0xE0 to 0xFF MIRP. Pops a control value index and a point, and moves the point from reference point 0 by that value.

name: tt_op_call
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x2B CALL. Pops a function number and runs the instructions of that function definition.

name: tt_op_fdef
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0

name: tt_op_loopcall
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x2A LOOPCALL. Pops a function number and a count and runs that function definition count times.

name: tt_op_call_user_defined
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Handles opcodes 0x83, 0x84 and 0x8F to 0xAF. Runs the instruction definition for the opcode, or aborts with error 0x1101.

name: tt_op_idef
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x89 IDEF. Pops an opcode number, records the start and length of the following body in the instruction definition table, and skips to ENDF.

name: tt_op_utp
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x29 UTP. Pops a point and clears its touched flag bits on the axes along which the freedom vector is not zero.

name: tt_op_sdb
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x5E SDB. Pops a value and stores it as the delta base of the graphics state.

name: tt_op_sds
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x5F SDS. Pops a value and stores it as the delta shift of the graphics state.

name: tt_op_deltap1
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x5D DELTAP1. Moves points by small stored exceptions for the current pixel size, using the delta base without offset.

convention: cdecl (exec ctx, callback(exec, zone, index, amount), short first_ppem, byte shift), ret 0

name: tt_op_deltap2

name: tt_op_deltap3
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x72 DELTAP3. Moves points by stored exceptions, using the delta base plus 32 pixel sizes.

name: tt_op_deltac1
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0

name: tt_op_deltac2
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x74 DELTAC2. Changes control value table entries by stored exceptions, using the delta base plus 16 pixel sizes.

name: tt_op_deltac3
convention: cdecl (exec ctx), ret 0
purpose: Opcode 0x75 DELTAC3. Changes control value table entries by stored exceptions, using the delta base plus 32 pixel sizes.

convention: cdecl (scale_info *s, int value) returns scaled int, ret 0
purpose: Scales a font unit value by a multiplier, adds a rounding offset and shifts right.

name: tt_scale_by_division
convention: cdecl (scale_info *s, int value) returns scaled int, ret 0
purpose: Scales a font unit value by a multiplier and divisor with rounding, keeping the result symmetric for negative values.

name: tt_scale_by_fixed_mul
convention: cdecl (scale_info *s, int value) returns scaled int, ret 0
purpose: Scales a font unit value by a 16.16 fixed point ratio stored in the scale record.

name: tt_exec_hint_glyph
convention: cdecl (exec *e, glyph *g) returns void, ret 0
purpose: Copies a glyph outline into the hinting context, scales its points by the size stretch ratios, rounds the phantom points and runs the glyph program.

name: tt_exec_destroy
convention: cdecl (exec *e) returns void, ret 0
purpose: Frees every buffer owned by a TrueType hinting context and then the context itself, skipping a null pointer.

name: tt_compute_scale_factor
convention: cdecl (int ppem, uint units_per_em, scale_info *out) returns void, ret 0
purpose: Builds the scaling record for a size, choosing a shift, a division or a 16.16 fixed ratio mode.

name: tt_find_table_by_tag
convention: cdecl (tt_font *font, uint tag) returns table entry pointer or 0, ret 0
purpose: Searches the font table directory for a table with the given four character tag and returns its entry.

name: tt_open_table_stream
convention: cdecl (tt_font *font, uint tag) returns input_stream pointer or 0, ret 0
purpose: Finds a table by tag in the font directory and opens an input stream over its bytes.

name: tt_font_get_glyph_count
convention: cdecl (tt_font *font) returns uint, ret 0
purpose: Returns the glyph count from the font header table, capped at one less than the entry count of a second table when that is smaller.

name: tt_font_load_glyph
convention: cdecl (tt_font *font, int glyph_index, undefined4 target, ushort *out_advance, ushort *out_second_metric) returns glyph pointer, ret 0
purpose: Loads one glyph by index from the glyf table, decoding its outline and metrics, or returns an empty glyph when no outline exists.

name: tt_glyph_decode_outline
convention: cdecl (mem ctx, input_stream *s, char keep_instructions, short lsb_x, short advance, short top, short bottom) returns glyph pointer, ret 0
purpose: Decodes one glyf table record into a glyph, handling simple outlines and composite glyphs, and adds the four phantom points.

name: tt_font_cmap_lookup
convention: cdecl (tt_font *font, uint char_code) returns glyph index, ret 0
purpose: Maps a character code to a glyph index through the font cmap table, loading the table on first use.

name: tt_cmap_load
convention: cdecl (mem ctx, short platform_id, short encoding_id, input_stream *s) returns cmap object pointer, ret 0
purpose: Parses the cmap directory, picks the best subtable for the platform and encoding, and caches the glyph indexes of the digits 0 to 9.

name: tt_font_is_digit_glyph
convention: cdecl (tt_font *font, short glyph_index) returns 1 or 0, ret 0
purpose: Reports whether a glyph index is one of the ten digit glyphs of the font, loading the cmap table first if needed.

name: tt_font_new
convention: cdecl (mem ctx, short kind, undefined4 arg3, undefined4 data_ref, spec *spec, int *err_out) returns font pointer or null, ret 0
purpose: Allocates and initialises a 0x68-byte font object and, for kind 2, loads the TrueType tables, then stores the glyph count.

name: tt_font_new_fragment_94300c
convention: Continuation of tt_font_new after its setjmp call. Uses the parent frame, EAX holds the setjmp result, ret 0
purpose: Allocates and initialises the 0x68-byte font object, loads its tables from the stream and sets the glyph count. On a longjmp it frees the context.

name: tt_font_load_tables
convention: cdecl(font* font, stream stream, int font_index), ret 0
purpose: Frees earlier table data, then reads the font header, the table directory and the head, hhea, vhea, maxp, loca, hmtx, vmtx, kern and post tables.

name: tt_kern_free_format0_table
convention: cdecl(block* pair_block), ret 0
purpose: Frees the pair array of a kern format 0 subtable and then the block itself. Accepts a null pointer.

name: tt_read_kern_table
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx, stream stream) -> kern_table*, ret 0
purpose: Reads a kern table with the Microsoft or Apple header, builds the subtable list and reads the format 0 kerning pairs of each subtable.

name: tt_read_table_directory_entry
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx, stream stream) -> entry*, ret 0
purpose: Reads one 16-byte table directory entry of the font file: tag, checksum, offset and length as big-endian words.

name: tt_read_hhea_or_vhea
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx, stream stream) -> metrics_header*, ret 0
purpose: Reads a 40-byte horizontal or vertical metrics header: a version word and sixteen 16-bit fields including ascender, descender and metric count.

name: tt_read_hmtx_or_vmtx
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx, stream stream, int glyph_count, int metric_count) -> metrics*, ret 0
purpose: Reads the advance and side bearing arrays of a metrics table and pads the advance array with the last advance for the remaining glyphs.

name: tt_font_get_units_per_em
convention: cdecl(font* font) -> short, ret 0
purpose: Returns the units per em from the head table, or 0x800 when the font has no head table.

name: tt_font_get_max_glyph_points
convention: cdecl(font* font) -> int, ret 0
purpose: Returns the larger of the simple glyph point limit and the composite glyph point limit from the maxp table.

name: tt_font_get_line_metrics
convention: cdecl(font* font, line_metrics* horizontal_out, line_metrics* vertical_out), ret 0
purpose: Fills horizontal and vertical metrics records from the hhea, vhea and post tables: ascender, descender, line gap, maximum advance, caret slope and underline values.

name: tt_font_free_cmap
convention: cdecl(font* font), ret 0
purpose: Frees the character map of a font with its entry arrays and main block, then clears the cmap field.

name: tt_font_free
convention: cdecl(font* font, int* status_out), ret 0
purpose: Frees a font object and every table it owns. With a status pointer, it sets a setjmp guard first.

name: tt_font_free_fragment_943f4f
convention: Continuation of tt_font_free after its setjmp call. Uses the parent frame, EAX holds the setjmp result, ret 0
purpose: Frees every table, array and sub-object of the font object when no error was raised, then the object itself.

name: lib_ctx_longjmp_error
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx, int error_code), no return
purpose: Writes the guard word 0x5500aaff into the context and longjmps to the jump buffer saved there, passing the error code.

name: lib_ctx_create
convention: cdecl(int* status_out) -> lib_ctx*, ret 0
purpose: Allocates the 0xa4-byte library context, its table of 0x1f5 tracked block pointers and six empty scratch buffer slots. Sets status 0x2718 on failure.

name: lib_ctx_acquire_scratch_buffer
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx, unsigned size, int slot) -> void*, ret 0
purpose: Returns a reusable scratch buffer for a slot and grows it when too small. Uses a plain allocation when the slot is not marked reusable.

name: lib_ctx_reset_scratch_buffers
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx), ret 0
purpose: Frees the six scratch buffers of the context, zeroes their sizes and sets their reusable flags to 1.

name: lib_ctx_destroy
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx), ret 0
purpose: Frees the six scratch buffers, then the tracked block table and the context itself.

name: lib_ctx_free_all_blocks
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx), ret 0
purpose: Frees every block still tracked in the context table, then the table and the context. Accepts a null pointer.

name: lib_mem_alloc
convention: cdecl (lib_context_t *ctx, int size) returns void *, ret 0
purpose: Allocates a guarded memory block for the embedded library and records it in the context's block table, raising a longjmp error on failure.

name: lib_mem_realloc
convention: cdecl(lib_ctx* ctx, void* block, int new_size) -> void*, ret 0
purpose: Resizes a guarded block. It checks the guard bytes, updates the tracking table and writes new guards. A bad guard raises a longjmp error.

name: lib_mem_free
convention: cdecl (lib_context_t *ctx, void *block), ret 0
purpose: Frees a guarded memory block of the embedded library after checking its guard bytes and its entry in the context table.

name: sort_int16_array_ascending
convention: cdecl(short* values, int count), ret 0
purpose: Sorts an array of signed 16-bit values into ascending order with a bubble sort.

name: fixed_mul
convention: cdecl (int a, int b), returns int
purpose: Multiplies two signed 16.16 fixed point numbers and returns the 16.16 result.

name: f26dot6_mul
convention: cdecl(int a, int b) -> int, ret 0
purpose: Multiplies two signed numbers and divides the product by 64, with sign handling and no 64-bit intermediate. Used for 26.6 fixed point.

name: f2dot14_mul
convention: cdecl(int value, short factor) -> int, ret 0
purpose: Multiplies a signed 32-bit value by a signed 16-bit 2.14 factor and shifts right by 14. Used for vector and matrix scaling.

name: fixed_div
convention: cdecl (int a, int b), returns int
purpose: Divides two signed 16.16 fixed point numbers and returns the 16.16 quotient.

name: fixed_hypot
convention: cdecl(int x, int y) -> int, ret 0
purpose: Returns the length of a vector from its two components in 16.16 fixed point by Newton iteration, using fixed_mul and fixed_div.

name: EnumPrintersA_import_thunk

purpose: Jumps through the import table to the Windows function EnumPrintersA.
